blocks.text: SHAH ALAM, Malaysia – The final decision on a pardon rests with the ruler of a state or the Yang di-Pertuan Agong, says Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim. Anwar said every prisoner, including former prime minister Najib Razak, had the right to submit a petition for consideration by the Pardons Board. “What I have said is that every prisoner has the right to submit a petition. I will continue to defend that right. “Anyone, including Datuk Seri Najib, has the right to submit a petition for consideration by the Pardons Board,” he said at a reunion tea gathering for Reformasi movement pioneers […]...
